title: Child
subtitle: 「小孩／兒童／未成年人／子女」，必須先分清日常年齡、法律身份、學校身份和家庭關係。
description: 「小孩／兒童／未成年人／子女」，必須先分清日常年齡、法律身份、學校身份和家庭關係。

words.example: The programme gives every youngster a chance to learn a new skill.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃讓每個小孩都有機會學習新技能。

exercises.original: The programme gives every child a chance to learn a new skill.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃讓每個小孩都有機會學習新技能。
exercises.upgrade: The programme gives every youngster a chance to learn a new skill.

options.explanation: 在一般社區／活動語境中，youngster 是 child 的自然、稍口語替代。
成年人和 child 的年齡分類相反。
只表示學生身份，不保證年齡是兒童。
受供養人士可以不是兒童。
只涵蓋十幾歲，不能概括所有 child。

exercises.original: Each child received a free book at the event.
exercises.zh: 活動中每個小孩都獲贈一本書。
exercises.upgrade: Each youngster received a free book at the event.

options.explanation: 也可，但本題目標是 youngster，語氣稍較中性。
event context 中泛指小孩很自然。
法律色彩太強，活動派書不需強調法律身份。
活動參加者未必全是學生。

exercises.original: The library has a reading corner for children.
exercises.zh: 圖書館設有兒童閱讀角。
exercises.upgrade: The library has a reading corner for youngsters.

options.explanation: 範圍較廣，可能包括較大青少年。
一般公共設施語境可自然代替 children。

words.example: The museum has a special area for kids.
words.exampleZh: 博物館設有一個專為小孩而設的區域。

exercises.original: The museum has a special area for children.
exercises.zh: 博物館設有專為小孩而設的區域。
exercises.upgrade: The museum has a special area for kids.

options.explanation: 日常、親切的場所宣傳語中非常自然。

exercises.original: When I was a child, I loved building model planes.
exercises.zh: 我小時候很喜歡砌模型飛機。
exercises.upgrade: When I was a kid, I loved building model planes.

options.explanation: when I was a kid 是非常自然的日常固定表達。
太正式，也不如 kid 自然。

exercises.original: Parents can bring their children to the family session.
exercises.zh: 家長可以帶小孩參加家庭環節。
exercises.upgrade: Parents can bring their kids to the family session.

options.explanation: family session 的日常宣傳語非常自然。

words.example: The service supports each young person during the transition to secondary school.
words.exampleZh: 這項服務支援每名年輕人在升讀中學期間的過渡。

exercises.original: The service assigns a mentor to each child as they enter secondary school.
exercises.zh: 服務為每名升讀中學的年輕人安排一名導師。
exercises.upgrade: The service assigns a mentor to each young person as they enter secondary school.

options.explanation: secondary school context 可能包括 older children/teenagers，範圍自然。
雖法律上可能成立，但服務語境不需法律分類。
只突出學校身份，忽略整體個人支援。

exercises.original: Every child should have someone they can talk to.
exercises.zh: 每名年輕人都應有可以傾訴的人。
exercises.upgrade: Every young person should have someone they can talk to.

options.explanation: 在支援／福祉語境中，包容較大兒童和青少年。
不一定所有孩子都是在學學生。

exercises.original: The policy considers the needs of children and teenagers together.
exercises.zh: 政策一併考慮兒童和青少年的需要。
exercises.upgrade: The policy considers the needs of young people.

options.explanation: 可概括較大兒童和青少年，最自然。
法律範圍受地區影響，且語氣偏法律。
不是所有 young people 都以學生身份被討論。

words.example: A parent or guardian must sign the form for a minor.
words.exampleZh: 未成年人須由父母或監護人簽署表格。

exercises.original: A parent must sign the form for a child who cannot legally consent.
exercises.zh: 未能依法自行同意的未成年人須由家長簽署表格。
exercises.upgrade: A parent must sign the form for a minor who cannot legally consent.

options.explanation: legally consent 是直接法律線索，minor 最精準。
太口語，無法承載法律身份。
學生身份和法律同意權不同。

exercises.original: The contract cannot be signed independently by a child under the legal age of adulthood.
exercises.zh: 未達法定成年年齡的人不能獨立簽署該合約。
exercises.upgrade: The contract cannot be signed independently by a minor.

options.explanation: 太廣，可能包括已成年年輕人。
below legal adulthood 是 minor 的核心定義。
經濟依賴不是合約能力的核心。

exercises.original: The law provides additional protections for children below adulthood.
exercises.zh: 法律為未成年人提供額外保障。
exercises.upgrade: The law provides additional protections for minors.

options.explanation: 原句可以，但法律語境要精確分類時 minors 更合適。
law + below adulthood 是標準法律用語。

words.example: The activity is designed for young children aged four to six.
words.exampleZh: 這項活動是為四至六歲的年幼兒童設計。

exercises.original: The toy is designed for children aged three to five.
exercises.zh: 這件玩具是為三至五歲的年幼兒童設計。
exercises.upgrade: The toy is designed for young children aged three to five.

options.explanation: ages three to five 明確屬年幼兒童。
雖法律上成立，但產品年齡定位太籠統。

exercises.original: Parents of small children can use the family entrance.
exercises.zh: 年幼兒童的家長可以使用家庭入口。
exercises.upgrade: Parents of young children can use the family entrance.

options.explanation: family entrance 語境通常指較年幼兒童。

exercises.original: The book explains emotions to children in the early years.
exercises.zh: 這本書向年幼兒童解釋情緒。
exercises.upgrade: The book explains emotions to young children.

words.example: The child waiting outside was a young girl from the neighbouring class.
words.exampleZh: 在外面等候的孩子是鄰班的一名小女孩。

exercises.original: The child waiting outside was a girl from the neighbouring class.
exercises.zh: 在外面等候的孩子是鄰班的一名女孩。
exercises.upgrade: The child waiting outside was a young girl from the neighbouring class.

options.explanation: 性別已知，且是學校日常描述，具體自然。
可表示學生，但會省略已知性別資訊。

exercises.original: The child in the photograph is a boy of about eight.
exercises.zh: 照片中的孩子是一名約八歲男孩。
exercises.upgrade: The child in the photograph is a young boy of about eight.

exercises.original: The story follows a child who moves to a new town with her family.
exercises.zh: 故事講述一名隨家人搬到新城市的女孩。
exercises.upgrade: The story follows a young girl who moves to a new town with her family.

options.explanation: her 已提供性別，故事敘述中自然。
可行但失去已知性別資訊。

words.example: The campaign teaches schoolchildren how to cross the road safely.
words.exampleZh: 這項運動教導學童如何安全過馬路。

exercises.original: The road-safety campaign is aimed at children who attend primary school.
exercises.zh: 道路安全運動以小學學童為對象。
exercises.upgrade: The road-safety campaign is aimed at primary schoolchildren.

options.explanation: attend primary school 是直接定義。

exercises.original: The museum offers free entry to local children attending school.
exercises.zh: 博物館向本地學童提供免費入場。
exercises.upgrade: The museum offers free entry to local schoolchildren.

options.explanation: local + attending school 可直接概括。

exercises.original: The crossing is used by hundreds of children on their way to school.
exercises.zh: 每天有數百名學童使用這個過路處上學。
exercises.upgrade: The crossing is used by hundreds of schoolchildren on their way to school.

options.explanation: 也可，但 schoolchildren 更直接保留 children + on their way to school。
是在學兒童的清楚概括。
可泛指小孩，但沒有學校身份那麼精準。

words.example: Each pupil receives a reading book at the start of term.
words.exampleZh: 每名學生在學期開始時都會獲發一本閱讀書。

exercises.original: Each child in the class receives a reading book.
exercises.zh: 班上每名學生都獲發一本閱讀書。
exercises.upgrade: Each pupil in the class receives a reading book.

options.explanation: in the class 明確是學校學生身份。
法律分類不是課堂角色。

exercises.original: The teacher spoke to the child about his homework.
exercises.zh: 老師和那名學生談他的功課。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher spoke to the pupil about his homework.

options.explanation: teacher + homework 是直接學校線索。
口語可行，但教育正式語境 pupil 更準。

exercises.original: The school records each child's progress every term.
exercises.zh: 學校每學期記錄每名學生的進度。
exercises.upgrade: The school records each pupil's progress every term.

options.explanation: 也可，但 possessive + progress in school 常用 pupil。
school records + progress + term 是典型教育行政用語。

words.meaning: 受供養兒童；受扶養子女
words.example: The allowance increases for each dependent child in the household.
words.exampleZh: 家庭中每名受供養兒童都會令津貼增加。

exercises.original: Families receive extra support for each child who depends on them financially.
exercises.zh: 家庭每有一名受供養兒童便可獲得額外支援。
exercises.upgrade: Families receive extra support for each dependent child.

options.explanation: financial dependence + family support 是典型福利／行政用法。
法律成年身份不等於福利上的 dependent。

exercises.original: The tax form asks how many children are financially supported by the applicant.
exercises.zh: 稅務表格詢問申請人供養多少名子女。
exercises.upgrade: The tax form asks how many dependent children the applicant supports.

options.explanation: tax form + financially supported 是直接行政線索。
法律未成年人不一定符合 dependent 定義。

exercises.original: The insurance policy covers the employee's children who meet dependency rules.
exercises.zh: 保險計劃涵蓋符合受供養條件的僱員子女。
exercises.upgrade: The insurance policy covers the employee's dependent children.

options.explanation: insurance + dependency rules 是標準行政表達。
是否上學不是保險資格核心。
太口語且不含依賴規則。
有些 dependent 子女可超過一般成年界線，視政策而定。

words.example: Their child is starting university this year.
words.exampleZh: 他們的孩子今年開始上大學。

exercises.original: Their child is starting university this year.
exercises.zh: 他們的孩子今年開始上大學。
exercises.upgrade: Their daughter is starting university this year.

options.explanation: 若已知 child 是女性，家庭關係語境最精準。
上大學者未必是法律未成年人。
太口語且失去親子關係。

exercises.original: His child lives abroad with her family.
exercises.zh: 他的女兒和家人住在海外。
exercises.upgrade: His daughter lives abroad with her family.

options.explanation: 可能正確，但沒有表達『他的孩子』這層家庭關係。
her 已知女性，且 possessive family relationship 是核心。
不合成人也可能是子女的語境。

exercises.original: She brought her child to the appointment.
exercises.zh: 她帶兒子來赴約。
exercises.upgrade: She brought her son to the appointment.

options.explanation: 若已知是男性，親子關係最精準。
只表示年輕男性，不一定強調是她的兒子。
口語可行但不如 son 精準。

words.example: The case was handled through the juvenile justice system.
words.exampleZh: 該案件透過少年司法制度處理。

exercises.original: The case involving a child offender was handled by a special court.
exercises.zh: 涉及未成年犯的案件由特別法庭處理。
exercises.upgrade: The case involving a juvenile offender was handled by a special court.

options.explanation: offender + special court 是典型少年司法語境。

exercises.original: The justice system has separate procedures for children who offend.
exercises.zh: 司法制度對未成年違法者設有不同程序。
exercises.upgrade: The justice system has separate procedures for juveniles who offend.

options.explanation: 也可法律上泛指未成年人，但 youth justice context 中 juvenile 更制度化。
justice system + offending 是直接制度線索。

exercises.original: The law distinguishes between adult and child offenders.
exercises.zh: 法律區分成年與未成年違法者。
exercises.upgrade: The law distinguishes between adult and juvenile offenders.

options.explanation: 也可，但法律制度分類中 juvenile offenders 更標準。
與 adult offenders 形成法律分類對比。

words.meaning: 未達法定年齡的人；未成年人
words.example: The venue must not serve alcohol to an underage person.
words.exampleZh: 場地不得向未達法定年齡的人士售酒。

exercises.original: The venue must not sell alcohol to a child below the legal drinking age.
exercises.zh: 場地不得向未達法定飲酒年齡的人售酒。
exercises.upgrade: The venue must not sell alcohol to an underage person.

options.explanation: legal drinking age 是特定活動的年齡限制，underage 最精準。
不表示是否低於法定飲酒年齡。
法律上的 juvenile 定義未必和飲酒年齡完全一致。

exercises.original: The website blocks users who are children under the required age.
exercises.zh: 網站會阻止未達規定年齡的用戶使用。
exercises.upgrade: The website blocks underage users.

options.explanation: 某服務的最低年齡可能低於法律成年年齡，因此 minor 不一定精準。
under the required age 直接對應。

exercises.original: The law restricts gambling by children who have not reached the legal age.
exercises.zh: 法律限制未達法定年齡人士參與賭博。
exercises.upgrade: The law restricts gambling by underage persons.

options.explanation: gambling has a specific legal age threshold，最精準。
未成年和 gambling age 可能不完全等同，視司法管轄區而定。

words.example: Each child participant must have parental consent.
words.exampleZh: 每名兒童參加者都必須取得家長同意。

exercises.original: Each child in the study must have parental consent.
exercises.zh: 研究中每名兒童參加者都必須取得家長同意。
exercises.upgrade: Each child participant in the study must have parental consent.

options.explanation: in the study + parental consent 表示研究角色就是參加者。
法律分類太泛，沒有 participant 角色。

exercises.original: The programme records feedback from every child taking part.
exercises.zh: 計劃記錄每名兒童參加者的意見。
exercises.upgrade: The programme records feedback from every child participant.

options.explanation: 也合理但可能包括較大青年。
taking part + child 明確組合成角色式表達。

exercises.original: The workshop limits each activity group to ten children.
exercises.zh: 工作坊每個活動小組最多十名兒童參加者。
exercises.upgrade: The workshop limits each activity group to ten child participants.

options.explanation: workshop group size 是活動參與角色。
可口語泛稱，但行政活動語境 child participants 更清楚。

words.meaning: 受照顧兒童；接受社會照護的兒童
words.example: The service provides extra support for children in care.
words.exampleZh: 這項服務為受照顧兒童提供額外支援。

exercises.original: The service gives extra support to children formally looked after by the local authority.
exercises.zh: 服務為由本地政府正式照顧的兒童提供額外支援。
exercises.upgrade: The service gives extra support to children in care.

options.explanation: formally looked after by the local authority 是社會照護制度的直接定義。
經濟依賴不等於接受公共照護。
太口語且失去制度身份。

exercises.original: The charity supports each child living in foster care.
exercises.zh: 慈善機構支援每名寄養中的受照顧兒童。
exercises.upgrade: The charity supports each child in care.

options.explanation: foster care 是直接社會照護線索。

exercises.original: The policy improves educational support for children looked after by public services.
exercises.zh: 政策改善受公共服務照顧兒童的教育支援。
exercises.upgrade: The policy improves educational support for children in care.

options.explanation: 只表示在學，沒有 public-care 身份。
looked after by public services 是核心。

falseSynonyms.zh: 嬰兒不等於所有 child baby 只指非常年幼的嬰孩；child 的年齡範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A baby is a very young child, but most children are not babies.

falseSynonyms.zh: 幼兒不等於所有 child toddler 通常指剛學行、年紀很小的兒童；範圍比 child 窄得多。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A toddler is one stage of childhood, not a general synonym for child.

falseSynonyms.zh: 青少年不等於所有 child teenager 通常指十三至十九歲的人；child 可以包括更年幼兒童，而法律上某些 teenagers 仍屬 minors。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Teenager is an age band; child is broader and depends on context.

falseSynonyms.zh: 成年人與 child 相反 adult 表示已成年人士；一般和 child 形成對比。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Adult is normally the opposite age category from child.

falseSynonyms.zh: 學生身份不等於 child student 描述教育身份，可以是兒童、青少年或成年人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A student may be a child or an adult; the words classify different things.

falseSynonyms.zh: 受供養人士不一定是 child dependent 可包括配偶、長者或其他受扶養人士；dependent child 才明確指兒童。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A dependent is not necessarily a child.

falseSynonyms.zh: 法律未成年人不總等於日常 child minor 在法律上很重要，但年齡界線受司法管轄區影響，而且某些較大的 minors 日常未必稱 child。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Minor is a legal category; child is a broader everyday and developmental term.

falseSynonyms.zh: 青年不一定是 child youth 可指青少年、青年人，亦可作集合名詞；通常年齡範圍比 child 更大、更模糊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Youth often extends beyond childhood and is not a precise replacement.
